assumptions.new_homes: PV of a healthy donor on the same feeder scaled to a fleet kWp draw; load of another donor; battery drawn from the fleet with the fleet's battery share (variant no_batteries: none)
assumptions.new_home_forecasts: donor M1/M2 forecasts scaled like the PV (proxy)
assumptions.limit: G = tau*G_max + (1 - tau)*G_cons (M8), unchanged when homes are added (same cable)
assumptions.physics: K1 battery_rollout; batteries start at e_min and carry energy across days; Sentinel = day-ahead LP per day + comfort-reserve clip, no intraday re-qualify / hourly re-solve

components.judge: ledger-only (no Judge weights); ledger chosen per run; grader real:sentinel.judge.grader.grade
